subject: NOAA NBM live precipitation: days 12-14 blended with the PRISM mean twice; PRISM-day totals added for sealed scoring
problem: When NBM precipitation probabilities existed for days 12-14, the 50/50 extension (mean of days 9-11 and the 42-day PRISM mean) was averaged with the PRISM mean a second time: about 25% NBM, 75% PRISM.
fix: Each of days 12-14 is blended once. Issues also store prism_day_precipitation_mm (12:00-12:00 UTC days, direct NBM QPF only) for scripts/noaa_precip_daily.py.
originals: All earlier issues are retained unchanged.
